data.Name: BSc in Architecture
data.universityName: University of Technology and Arts in Applied Sciences in Warsaw
data.EntryRequirement: Grade 12 with a minimum of 55–60% from a recognised institution. Applicants are also required to submit a portfolio consisting of 5–10 pencil drawings in at least A3 format, including 3 drawings representing architecture and 2 drawings representing compositions of simple geometric shapes, equipment, and textiles.
data.Remarks: The portfolio should be accompanied by a statement that the work submitted was produced independently (available under the link that Admissions Team will send to upload portfolio). The works will be assessed by the admissions committee on their ability to use perspective, observation of chiaroscuro, proportion, and detail. The examples of a proper portfolio drawings you will find here:https://akademiata.pl/en/the-examples-of-a-proper-portfolio-drawings/. We would like to remind you that the given works are inspirations only, not a copy material. you are expected to upload your portfolio (each drawing as a separate pdf file) under the link that admissions team will send you after verification of your documents.
